mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_commands (command_id, agent_code, command_type, attempt_no, task_id, step_seq, capability_type, command_payload, command_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{agentCode}, #{commandType}, #{attemptNo}, #{taskId}, #{stepSeq}, #{capabilityType}, #{commandPayload}, #{commandStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (agent_code, command_id, command_type, attempt_no) DO NOTHING
